description:
You are one of several procurement officers at a hospital network choosing a vendor for a new patient-records system. Each officer has reviewed different parts of the bids and reference checks.

The options are:
- Vendor A (Beltirlu Yervokmo)
- Vendor B (Ithvoktal Yervok)
- Vendor C (Kebreith Talnolans)
- Vendor D (Talmirdra Anstiroz)

Exactly one option is best overall. Which vendor should be selected? Your notes are incomplete: other participants hold information you do not have.

agents.shard_text:
Vendor A (Beltirlu Yervokmo):
  - Vendor A passed an independent security audit
  - Vendor A had a pilot cancelled at a peer hospital
  - Vendor A is financially stable
  - Vendor A offers 24/7 on-call support
  - Vendor A reported 7 major outages last year
Vendor B (Ithvoktal Yervok):
  - Vendor B has no published product roadmap
  - Vendor B has strong references from similar hospitals
  - Vendor B completed a successful pilot at a peer hospital
  - Vendor B is fully compliant with health-data regulations
  - Vendor B quoted a total cost of 387 thousand per year
  - Vendor B currently serves 41 hospital clients

  - Vendor C has poor references from similar hospitals

  - Vendor C has unresolved compliance findings
